classification.difficultyReason: Multi-part area context: build 2x+6, expand (2x+6)^2, get the path area by subtraction, then form and solve a linear equation. It needs several linked decisions but each is signposted.

content.prompt: A square swimming pool of side length $2x$ m is surrounded by a path 3 m wide.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Write an expression for the side length of the pool and path together.

answer.worked:
The path adds 3 m on each side of the pool.
$$\begin{align*}s&=3+2x+3\\s&=2x+6\text{ m}\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Write an expression for the area of the pool and path together. Expand your answer.

answer.worked:
For the perfect square, $a=2x$ and $b=6$.
$$\begin{align*}A&=(2x+6)^2\\A&=(2x)^2+2(2x)(6)+6^2\\A&=4x^2+24x+36\text{ m}^2\end{align*}$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: Write an expression for the area of the path.

answer.worked:
Subtract the area of the pool, $(2x)^2=4x^2$.
$$\begin{align*}A_{\text{path}}&=4x^2+24x+36-4x^2\\A_{\text{path}}&=24x+36\text{ m}^2\end{align*}$$

children.label: d
children.prompt: The area of the path is $132\text{ m}^2$. Find $x$.
